title: Fix bugs in a Rust string parsing module
description: Brownfield Rust dirty_cleanup: fix three intentional bugs in string utility functions (trim_and_upper returns lowercase, count_words counts characters, split_on_comma doesn't split on commas).

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs.

Bug 1 — trim_and_upper: uses to_lowercase() instead of to_uppercase().
  Fix: change .to_lowercase() to .to_uppercase()

Bug 2 — count_words: returns s.len() (byte count) instead of word count.
  Fix: return s.split_whitespace().count()

Bug 3 — split_on_comma: splits on whitespace instead of commas.
  Fix: s.split(',').map(|p| p.to_string()).collect()

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: trim_and_upper trims and converts to uppercase
count_words splits on whitespace and counts
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
